mechanics.claim: Aphelios has 5 weapons and is only ever equipped with 2 (main and off-hand); he starts with Calibrum main / Severum off-hand, and Gravitum, Infernum, Crescendum queued in reserve in that order.
mechanics.quote: '''Aphelios''' begins the game with {{ai|Calibrum|Aphelios}} as his {{as|main weapon}} and {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} in his {{as|off-hand}}, with {{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}}, {{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}, and {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}} queued in reserve.

mechanics.claim: Moonlight is spent on every basic attack and on every Q cast, but abilities that make Aphelios auto-attack as part of their effect (Onslaught, Duskwave's follow-up, Sentry) do not spend additional Moonlight for those attacks.
mechanics.quote: Any of his abilities that automatically cause him to attack during their effect will not consume additional ''Moonlight''.

mechanics.claim: When the main weapon's Moonlight hits zero it goes to the back of the reserve queue and Alune assembles the next weapon; Aphelios cannot toggle Phase during that assembly.
Calibrum's empowered snipe is fired by whichever weapon is currently the main weapon if Calibrum itself is off-hand (the off-hand weapon fires it only when Calibrum is main).
mechanics.quote: If '''Calibrum''' is the current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, the {{as|main weapon}} is used for the attack instead.

mechanics.claim: The empowered snipe consumes the mark(s) on whatever targets currently carry one; against a single target only one mark can be outstanding (it is a duration debuff, not a stacking counter), so at most one 15 (+15% bonus AD) instance is dealt per snipe in a single-target fight.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will consume the marks from all targets, dealing {{as|15|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to the main target for each mark consumed.

mechanics.claim: Gravitum's basic attack applies a slow (30% decaying to 10% after 0.7s over 2.5s total) but no bonus damage; the slow itself is a pure utility effect the damage fight does not score, though its presence on the target is what Binding Eclipse (Q) requires to be castable.
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks with '''Gravitum''' {{tip|slow}} enemies by 30% for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, decaying to 10% after {{fd|0.7}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Infernum's fire bolt splits into a cone of secondary bolts behind the primary target; against a single stationary dummy with no other enemies, there is nothing behind the target for these bolts to hit, so this component of Infernum's attack never deals damage in this fight.
mechanics.quote: shoot a fire bolt that upon arrival splits into a cone of 4 lesser bolts behind the target, dealing damage to enemies they pass through

mechanics.claim: Crescendum's basic attack throws the blade and Aphelios cannot attack again until it returns to him (a self-inflicted attack lock whose length depends on travel distance to and from the target).
mechanics.quote: He is unable to declare basic attacks until he retrieves '''Crescendum''', but the attack timer is reset {{tt|once caught|This does not persist when swapping weapons.}}.

mechanics.claim: While holding Chakrams, Crescendum's own attack windup is reduced (further reduced again on a crit), independent of the per-Chakram bonus damage.
mechanics.quote: have a lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} of {{ap|0.159999996423721/1.5*100|round=2}}%, further decreased to {{ap|0.100000001490116/1.5*100|round=2}}% when {{tip|critically strike|critically striking}}
